cases.input: The printer only prints blank white pages

runs.answer:
Based on **“Printer output is empty or faded”**:

1. Check that the toner cartridge is seated firmly. If it’s new, make sure the orange protective strip was removed.
2. Print a configuration page from the printer menu.
   - If it’s blank too, the printer needs a new cartridge; Facilities can supply one.
   - If it prints correctly, reinstall the printer from the self service portal.

args.query: printer printing blank white pages troubleshooting

results.title: Printer output is empty or faded
results.content: When a network printer feeds paper but the sheets come out without any print, the cause is almost always the toner. Open the front panel and check that the cartridge is seated firmly and that the orange protective strip has been removed from a new cartridge. Print a configuration page from the printer menu: if that page is also empty, the device needs a new cartridge, which facilities can supply. If the configuration page looks fine, the problem is in the document or driver, so reinstall the printer from the self service portal.

judge.reasoning: The answer names the correct article and accurately covers checking the toner cartridge and protective strip, printing a configuration page, and reinstalling the printer from the self-service portal when appropriate. It does not escalate.

cases.input: I already restarted the VPN client and it still doesn't work

runs.answer:
According to **“VPN and remote access troubleshooting,”** try these steps:

1. Check that your home internet works by opening a public website.
2. Sign out of the VPN client, quit it completely, then start it again.
3. Check that the gateway is `vpn.corp.example.com`.
4. If you’re on hotel or café Wi‑Fi, try a phone hotspot.
5. If you see a certificate error, the laptop may need to connect to the domain in the office.

If it still doesn’t work, contact the Service Desk and include the error message and steps you’ve tried:

"IT Service Desk
Email: servicedesk@example.com
Portal: https://support.example.com
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00.
Include a description of the problem, the steps you have already tried, and any error messages."

results.title: VPN and remote access troubleshooting
results.content: Internal systems are only reachable through the corporate VPN when you work outside the office. If the GlobalConnect client fails to establish a tunnel, first confirm that your home internet connection works by opening a public website. Then sign out of the client, quit it completely and start it again. Make sure the gateway is set to vpn.corp.example.com. Hotel and cafe networks sometimes block VPN traffic; switching to a phone hotspot is a quick way to test this. Certificate errors usually mean the laptop has not synced with the domain for a while and must be connected in the office once.

cases.input: How do I get a second monitor for my desk?

runs.answer:
Order a monitor through the hardware catalogue in the self-service portal. Standard items within your role’s equipment allowance are approved automatically and usually arrive at the office within five working days. If it’s outside the catalogue or over your allowance, the portal will request your line manager’s approval.

results.title: Requesting new equipment
results.content: Laptops, monitors, docking stations, headsets and other peripherals are ordered through the hardware catalogue in the self service portal. Standard items that fall within the equipment allowance for your role are approved automatically, and delivery to the office usually takes five working days. Anything outside the catalogue, or above the allowance, requires approval from your line manager, which the portal requests on your behalf. Laptops are replaced on a four year cycle; earlier replacement is only possible if the device is faulty and has been assessed by the service desk.

results.title: Handling suspicious messages
results.content: Phishing messages try to trick you into clicking a link, opening an attachment or sharing your credentials, often by pretending to be a manager, a supplier or IT. Do not click links or open attachments in a message you did not expect. Use the Report button in the Outlook toolbar, which sends the message to the security team and removes it from your inbox. If you already entered your password on a suspicious page, change your password immediately and treat it as a security incident. Never forward the message to colleagues as a warning.

cases.input: Nobody can hear me in Teams meetings

runs.answer:
In the Teams meeting, open **Device settings** and make sure the correct microphone is selected and not muted. If you’re using a headset connected through a dock, connect it directly to your laptop. You can also use Teams’ **test call** to check the microphone.

Based on **“Sound and microphone problems in Teams calls.”**

args.query: Nobody can hear my microphone/audio in Microsoft Teams meetings troubleshooting microphone permissions device selection mute

results.title: Sound and microphone problems in Teams calls
results.content: If other participants cannot hear you, or you cannot hear them, first open the device settings in Teams during the call and confirm that the correct speaker and microphone are selected. Headsets connected through a docking station are sometimes not picked up, so try connecting them directly to the laptop. Check that the microphone is not muted by a physical switch on the headset. Use the test call function in the settings to record and play back a short message. Bluetooth headsets should be paired again if the audio is choppy or keeps dropping out.

judge.reasoning: The answer names the correct article and covers microphone selection, connecting the headset directly instead of through a dock, and using a test call. It mentions checking mute status but does not specifically tell the user to check the headset’s physical mute switch.
